en.title: New development in investigation into FETÖ's 'marriage' structure in public sector
en.summary: An operation targeting FETÖ/PDY's covert marriage network in the public sector across 15 provinces centered in Ankara resulted in 26 suspects being detained, with 15 subsequently arrested.

en.title: Dirty network from massage salons: Catalog-based prostitution ring dismantled
en.summary: An operation targeted suspects allegedly operating prostitution networks through massage salons and beauty centers across three provinces centered in Adana.

stories.title: Masaj salonu ve güzellik merkezlerine fuhuş operasyonu | Müşterilerine katalog göndermiş

en.title: Police Operation Against Prostitution in Massage Parlors and Beauty Centers | Sent Catalogs to Customers
en.summary: Authorities in three provinces centered on Adana arrested 18 suspects, including 7 women, for operating prostitution through massage parlors and beauty centers. The suspects allegedly sent catalogs containing photos of coerced women to contacts through social media accounts opened in their businesses' names.

stories.title: İstanbul için tarih verildi: Sağanak geliyor, sıcaklık 14 dereceye düşecek

en.title: Date Set for Istanbul: Heavy Rain Coming, Temperature to Drop to 14 Degrees
en.summary: Temperatures in Istanbul will reach 26 degrees over the weekend before declining next week. Forecasts indicate temperatures dropping to around 20 degrees on Wednesday.

stories.title: İstanbul’da hava değişiyor: AKOM sağanak yağış için tarih verdi

en.title: Weather Changing in Istanbul: AKOM Sets Date for Heavy Rain
en.summary: No rainfall is expected in Istanbul today or in the coming days, but weather conditions will change midweek. Scattered rain is forecast for Tuesday, with heavy precipitation expected on Wednesday.

stories.title: Yargıtay’dan emsal nafaka kararı: Aynı gelire sahip eşe yoksulluk nafakası yok!

en.title: Landmark Decision from Court of Cassation on Alimony: No Spousal Support for Wife with Equal Income
en.summary: The Court of Cassation ruled that a woman with income equal to her ex-husband and regular earnings should not receive spousal support. The court determined that the woman's pension and stable income make such support unlawful.

stories.title: Masaj salonu ve güzellik merkezlerine operasyon: Kataloglu fuhuş çetesi çökertildi

en.title: Operation against massage parlors and beauty centers: Catalog-based prostitution ring dismantled
en.summary: Authorities conducted an operation across three provinces centered in Adana, arresting 18 suspects for operating prostitution through massage parlors and beauty centers. The suspects used social media accounts to send catalogs containing photos of women they coerced into prostitution.

stories.title: Yargıtay'dan yeni nafaka kararı: Bu şartları taşıyanlar artık alamayacak

en.title: New alimony decision from Court of Cassation: Those meeting these conditions will no longer receive it
en.summary: Turkey's Court of Cassation Second Civil Division issued a ruling restricting alimony payments to women who have equal income levels and regular earnings as their ex-spouses.

en.title: Minister Ersoy launches event in capital! Ankara Culture Road Festival begins
en.summary: Culture and Tourism Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy inaugurated the Ankara Culture Road Festival by visiting four exhibitions at CSO Ada Ankara.

en.summary: In an investigation into the suspicious death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu in prison, the Silivri Chief Prosecutor and a prison prosecutor on duty at the time were arrested.

en.summary: University students are eagerly awaiting announcements from Turkey's Youth and Sports Ministry regarding the start dates for KYK scholarship and loan applications.

en.summary: Türk Telekom has established a research and innovation scientific board composed of six scientists from Turkey and worldwide to focus on 6G, artificial intelligence, quantum technologies, and satellite communications.

en.summary: Turkey has identified priority areas for public investments during 2027-2029, with projects planned to support private sector investment and regional development across production, employment, energy, defense, and agriculture.

en.title: Fed raises interest rates for the first time since 2023: Global markets focus on next week's data
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75-4 percent, marking its first increase since 2023, while the dollar index and U.S. Treasury yields strengthened.

en.title: When will YKS supplementary preference results be announced, on which date?
en.summary: Supplementary preferences for the YKS university entrance exam opened on September 17 at 4 PM, with results pending. The official examination board has not yet disclosed when results will be released.
